item.title: Loving Difficult Family Members While Maintaining Your Peace
item.description: Loving difficult family members is a challenge. Some of us experience trying times at the hand of our family members and it can be hard to love them, even when we have grown up and moved away. God doesn't want us to hate our family members; instead, He wants us to love them. Love is a choice – it is not a feeling. Ask the Lord to help you love your difficult family members. item.title: Are Small Groups or Sunday Schools Better?
item.description: Historically, circles (small groups) and rows (Sunday School) have battled over discipleship in the church. Each has similar goals with different applications, yet the estranged relationship continues in conversation even today.

item.title: A Prayer to Reflect the Humble Heart of Jesus - Your Daily Prayer - February 15
item.description: True humility isn’t about thinking less of yourself; it’s about living for something greater. This devotional calls us to reflect Christ’s humble heart in all we do.
